\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

This compiling project is the architectural smoke test for the manuscript workspace.
It exposes \ppvalue{example-count} generated value to verify that empirical
results enter
through a narrow, replaceable interface rather than as literals copied into prose; the
source itself follows the standard LaTeX model described by \citet{lamport1994latex}.

\begin{proposition}\label{prop:separation}
  A content chapter can compile under a different target adapter without owning its
  document class or layout.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
  The chapter imports only semantic commands supplied by the enclosing target.
\end{proof}

\Cref{prop:separation} is an architectural invariant rather than a substantive research
claim.
